description: C# controller class for handling user-related API endpoints in an ASP.NET Core application, providing actions to get current user details and update user info.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: API controller for user-related operations, utilizing MediatR for command/query dispatching, secured with JWT authorization.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current user's details using their username.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the current user's information via a command object.
